patch.value: GH-885: create-time close_reason_required recovery recommends an impossible different-command retry

GitHub issue #885 proves that when create requests a terminal status without closure evidence, close_reason_required lists only pm close examples against an item that was never created. The working create --resolution recovery is omitted, so the otherwise structured recovery bundle is not independently actionable.

Recovery examples and next steps are generated from the failing action contract and lead with the smallest valid same-command retry; CLI and SDK structured error contracts expose the same typed recovery with exact flag domains; A recovery-closure gate proves the refusal is actionable without help or source lookup and retains correct update/close-specific advice
pm-cli 2026.8.3; default governance.require_close_reason; pm create --status closed without resolution
Run pm --json create with a terminal status and no closure evidence; inspect examples, next_steps, and recovery fields
The recovery bundle names the valid same-command flag and produces a directly executable minimal retry
Every example uses pm close against a nonexistent ID and next_steps omit --resolution
Agents take an avoidable help/exploration loop, disable governance, or fall back to a non-atomic create-then-close sequence
